title: terminals.subscribe result

id.description: A terminal's id: a version 4 UUID the opening client mints, unique on the environment and never reused, kept in lowercase.

sessionId.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

openedAt.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

cols.description: A terminal's width in columns, 1 to 1,000.

rows.description: A terminal's height in rows, 1 to 1,000.

exitCode.description: The shell's exit code once it has exited; null while it runs.

signal.description: The signal that ended the shell, when one did; null otherwise or while it runs.

terminal.description: A terminal: its id, session, when it opened, its size, and its exit code once it has exited.

scrollback.description: The retained output, oldest first: at most 5,000 lines or 8 MiB.

firstSequence.description: The sequence of the oldest chunk retained; 0 while there is none.

lastSequence.description: The sequence of the newest chunk; 0 before any output. The snapshot frame's sequence.

truncated.description: True when older output was dropped at the cap: the scrollback is the retained tail, and a cursor older than firstSequence missed what was dropped.

description: A terminal's snapshot: the terminal and its retained scrollback with the sequences it spans.
